claims.finding: The quarter being reported (Q2/H1 2026) contains a multi-week unpaid gap on the Clean Energy - redelivered from SEFE 'in early April 2026' and only delivered to Rio Grande 'at the end of April 2026' per the company's own Q1 release - and it also loses the $4.9m of non-recurring insurance 'Other income' that supplied roughly $0.13 of Q1's $0.43 headline EPS, so the Q2 bar is materially lower than the 'higher daily rate ... accretive' framing that is the only Clean Energy commentary in circulation.
claims.why_not_priced: consensus_eps_forecast is null on one estimate (event.json) and the search trace records WallStreetZen showing a 1Y price target of 'N/A' and no Stifel rating action since 2023, so there is no published number for the quarter to be marked against and no analyst to net the idle days off the higher rate. Every third-party summary in the corpus - the TipRanks headline 'Secures Higher-Rate Charter for Clean Energy', the StockTitan 'LNG shipping rates surge, Dynagas sits on $0.8B in long-term charters' - carries the accretion and drops the ~25 unpaid days and the insurance reversal. If this were priced, a $138m-cap name with 50k shares of daily volume would not be sitting exactly flat over both 5 and 20 days into the print.
claims.independence: The same underlying utilisation decay shows up independently in the FY2025 release, which reports fleet utilisation of 98.8% in Q4 2025 and 100.0% in Q4 2024 against the 95.1% Q1 2026 print, and flags 'the decrease in Revenue earning days of one of our vessels due to unscheduled repairs': https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/DLNG/6-k-dynagas-lng-partners-lp-current-report-foreign-issuer-3546ebeb2ab3.html

claims.finding: The Arctic Aurora - the single vessel that accounted for the Equinor charter, 25% of FY2025 revenue - comes off Equinor and onto its new ~7-year Rio Grande LNG fixture 'commencing between September - November 2026', i.e. inside the current quarter, and the Clean Energy precedent in the same charter package says such a handover costs roughly three to four weeks of unpaid hire; this print is where that timetable gets set.

claims.why_not_priced: The Sept-Nov 2026 commencement window is buried in a July 2023 press release; neither of the two most recent company releases in the corpus mentions the Arctic Aurora transition at all - both discuss only the Clean Energy - and the Arctic Aurora is the vessel whose lower rate the company itself blamed for the adjusted-income decline in Q4 2025 and again in Q1 2026. With one estimate and no price target on the name there is nobody modelling a Q3/Q4 off-hire window on 17% of the fleet. If it were priced the stock would not be flat over 20 days with the transition month already underway.
claims.independence: The revenue weight comes from a different document: the FY2025 20-F, whose charterer concentration is recorded as SEFE 40% / Yamal 35% / Equinor 25% - https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1578453/000110465926040882/dlng-20251231x20f.htm (search_trace/20260904T154434Z.json, area 5). The Arctic Aurora's $125.2m sale-and-leaseback balance, the largest of the four, is in the Q1 6-K.

claims.finding: Dynagas restated its own results date twice inside two days - GlobeNewswire 2026-09-01 said after the close on Monday September 7 (a US market holiday), GlobeNewswire 2026-09-02 corrected it to before the open on Tuesday September 8 - and the results 6-K was in fact only accepted at 2026-09-09 05:24 ET, a further day late.

claims.why_not_priced: The two conflicting date announcements were tiny wire items on a nano-cap and the third slip is visible only by comparing the corrected release against the filing's actual acceptance stamp - nothing aggregates that. A results date that moves three times in a partnership whose 36%-of-revenue charterer faces a January 1 2027 legal cliff, and which has told the market that disagreement 'could result in disputes, nonperformance, litigation, or early termination', is a weak but real friction tell. Marked small and wide because I cannot read either press release body and cannot rule out a third, uncaptured announcement that made September 9 public before the print.
